scope: Retrospective chronological event audit using pre-existing daily provider samples. Specifications chosen after events; not a preregistered untouched event holdout. No onchain covariates or ABM structural parameters are transferred.

events.protocol: 30-point training warmup; ≥20 resolved chronological residuals; last 60 residuals; gamma=0.02; bounded alpha in [0.005,0.5] with finite-quantile floor 1/(n+1). Nominal 90% intervals; empirical coverage only; no per-event coverage guarantee.
